title: FuseMetrics Lab: Experimental Analytics and Reproducibility Platform for radar data fusion (S3)
description: FuseMetrics Lab (software component S3) is a self-contained C++17 platform that automates the computational experiments, statistical analysis and evidence tables for the UST-Fuse study. It joins the ground-truth corpus from RadarTwin-UAV (S1) with the fusion outputs from UST-Fuse Engine (S2) at the scenario level and computes detection (probability of detection, false-alarm rate), classification (precision, recall, macro-F1, confusion matrix), calibration (Expected/Maximum Calibration Error, Brier score) and tracking (MOTA, MOTP, IDF1, fragmentation, ID switches, RMSE) metrics with multi-run bootstrap confidence intervals. It performs a component-ablation study, a baseline comparison against JPDA, CNN, LSTM, Kalman, SORT and DeepSORT, and non-parametric significance testing (Wilcoxon signed-rank with Holm correction), exporting CSV summaries, a LaTeX table snippet and an SVG figure ready for direct inclusion in a publication. A leak-free scenario-level train/calibration/validation/test split and fixed random seeds ensure reproducibility. Reference software accompanying the manuscript on Uncertainty-Aware Spatiotemporal Radar Fusion (UST-Fuse). Part 3 of 3 (S1, S2, S3).
